message.content: Now let me look at the build script to understand how to build the vulnerable target:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh:
     1	
     2	./bootstrap
     3	./configure                                 --enable-fuzz-targets                   --enable-application-coap               --enable-application-coap-secure        --enable-border-agent                   --enable-border-router                  --enable-cert-log                       --enable-channel-manager                --enable-channel-monitor                --enable-child-supervision              --enable-cli                            --enable-commissioner                   --enable-dhcp6-client                   --enable-dhcp6-server                   --enable-dns-client                     --enable-diag                           --enable-dns-client                     --enable-ecdsa                          --enable-ftd                            --enable-jam-detection                  --enable-joiner                         --enable-legacy                         --enable-mac-filter                     --enable-mtd-network-diagnostic         --enable-ncp                            --with-ncp-bus=uart                     --enable-raw-link-api                   --enable-service                        --enable-sntp-client                    --enable-udp-forward                    --disable-docs
     4	make -j$(nproc)
     5	find . -name '*-fuzzer' -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
     6	find . -name '*-fuzzer.dict' -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
     7	find . -name '*-fuzzer.options' -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
     8	fuzzers=$(find tests/fuzz -name "*-fuzzer")
     9	for f in $fuzzers; do
    10	    fuzzer=$(basename $f -fuzzer)
    11	    if [ -d "tests/fuzz/corpora/${fuzzer}" ]; then
    12	        zip -j $OUT/$(basename $f)_seed_corpus.zip tests/fuzz/corpora/${fuzzer}/*
    13	    fi
    14	done
